practicals.title: Practical List
content: To define the Front Panel Indicators, Switches and Rear Side
Connector in a CPU. (USB Hub, HDMI Port, CD/DVD Tray, COM
Port), Study the Short Conventions and Abbreviations of
Computer., To define Computer Internal Components.
(Motherboard, FDD, HDD, CD/DVD and Add-On Cards), Prepare a
summary report about Computer System, Power System of
Computing, Motherboard and BIOS., To configure BIOS Setup.
(POST, Bootstrap Loader)., Install Windows Operating System to
your PC., Install Dual OS (Windows and Linux) to your PC., Study
different Monitors, Keyboard Devices and prepare a short Report
about it., Study different Mouse, Printer and Speaker Devices and
prepare a short Report about it., To install and configure a Printer,
Scanner, Webcam, Biometric Devices and use its services., To study
how to Data can be Transferred between different devices.
(Bluetooth and PC), To study the use of 3-D Printer., Study
different Storage Components and prepare a short Report about it.,
Study how to install Hard Drive to your PC and partitioning of it.,
Demonstrate how to format Hard Drive., Study different format of
CD and copy data into it., To install and configure a DVD Writer
and demonstrate to write DVD., To create Cross Wires and Direct
Cables., Prepare a summary report about Laptop and its peripherals.,
To study some CMD Prompt¶s commands. (HDD Open, Folder
Creation etc.)
Total Hours 40
